svg.title: 1-roll v2 schematic
svg.text: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8, two load cells under the axle ends, 150 W PTC heater, blower, SHT40 chamber probe, DS18B20 heater-outlet probe, 2.8" capacitive touch screen, buzzer. Crossing wires are not joined unless a dot is shown.
USB-C: power + flashing · 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM

Heater path (thick lines): 150 W at 12 V is about 12.5 A. 20 A fuse, 14 AWG silicone wire soldered straight to Q1's drain and source legs, not along perfboard tracks; KSD301 16 A and thermal fuse 15 A (the common 10 A ones are too small).
Q1's gate is driven from 12 V through the PC817 (about 11 V on). At power-up GPIO4 floats: the PC817 stays dark and R3 holds Q1 off; R5 holds the blower's Q2 off.

Touch screen: SPI for the picture, its touch chip on a second I2C bus (address 0x38, the same as an AHT20). LED is the backlight's control input (the module switches it with its own transistor); if yours lights only with LED on 3V3, wire it there.
Load cell wire colours vary between makers: a cell that reads backwards still works (the calibration takes the sign), but swap A+/A− for tidiness.
On the board: C1 100 µF 25 V and C2 100 nF across the 12 V input, C3 100 nF across 3V3/GND near the HX711s. All grounds (⏚) meet at J1's black wire.
